scope: Manual second-round editorial review of 4 actual Egyptian automotive pages; content quality not word count
method: Reasoned editorial rubric, not Google rating. Scores reflect user intent coverage, verifiable Egyptian model facts, actionable diagnostics, documentation and visual UX; keep passing posts unchanged.

findings: Correctly warns A8 1.4 TSI Egypt has conventional eight-speed AT, A8 RS may be DSG; however ~270 words do not supply actionable differential tests, 7-speed DSG controller data, model-year-specific fluid/coding workflow or actual owner troubleshooting.
No reference to exact factory Egyptian 2021 A8 service maintenance chart or OEM Egypt launch information, although these facts are critical to stopping DSG repairs on an 8AT.
No internal diagram, no diagnostic matrix, no safety-specific stop-driving thresholds.

Useful correction from old Valvematic confusion, but lacks detailed engine-vs-CVT fault isolation, fluid and level procedure guard, Hybrid HEV distinct configuration and differential diagnosis for whining vs wheel-bearing vs engine load.
Toyota Egypt 2026 brochure documents 1.6 120hp/154Nm and 1.8 HEV variants and CVT, but current live page does not link manufacturer primary document.
No side-by-side symptom tests, table or owner workflow; users cannot decide what to test first.

Correct basic principles leak-test before replacing evaporator and hot-no-start requires CKP signal testing, yet 240 words do not distinguish cabin airflow loss, compressor control, radiator/condenser fan performance, refrigerant pressure safety and exact trim-dependent AC.
Official Nissan Egypt specs show manual and automatic AC by trim with rear cooling fan vents: this material trim distinction and dual failure routes are absent.
No substantive repair sequence/table, no primary source links or images embedded in body.
Already in-depth >2000-word published explanation with manufacturer specific 7DCT source, in-place original diagram, diagnosis table and safety protocol; word count is not reason for edits.
No high-priority factual gap found in sampling; leave unchanged.
